desc: The M4-22 Micro Compact Pistol is a premium .22 caliber semi-automatic AR styled pistol with aluminum upper and lower receivers and all the features of a true M4 pistol. The Micro Elite Pistol features a 7 inch barrel, 5.5 inch aluminum MLok handguard, Compact Bolt System, Rear Pic Rail Adapter and weighs only 4.35 lbs.
